content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Bodh Gaya AI/ML - IoT Developer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Bodh Gaya AI/ML - IoT Developer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the AI/ML - IoT Developer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the AI/ML - IoT Developer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A four-year bachelor's degree in engineering or technology in relevant fields is required, with options for Master's degrees and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the AI/ML - IoT Developer role?
faq.answer: The salary varies based on the project associate level, ranging from 37000/- + HRA to 57000/- + HRA, with an intern stipend of 12000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their application via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AI/ML - IoT Developer position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes document scrutiny, interaction, document verification, written test, skill test, and interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIM Bodh Gaya located?
faq.answer: IIM Bodh Gaya is located in Bodh Gaya, Bihar.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
